goal: Decide whether a CHAOSS metric value series shows a signal worth acting on, by the standard rule for telling a special cause from the ordinary variation of a process, never by a threshold chosen here.

app.name: uor-intervention-signal
app.title: Intervention signal
app.purpose: Decide, for one oracle computation of one subject at the ISO 8601 week grain, whether its individuals control chart (ISO 7870-2:2023) shows the series rising, falling, steady, or too short to have control limits, from the size of its baseline and the two tests for special causes over the latest complete weeks.

fields.name: baseline
fields.means: enough: at least 20 complete weeks precede the nine-week test window, the fewest subgroups ISO 7870-2:2023 computes preliminary control limits from; short: fewer

fields.name: latest
fields.means: ISO 7870-2:2023 test 1 on the latest complete week: high: its value is above the upper control limit; low: below the lower one; inside: neither; limits are the baseline mean plus or minus 2.66 times its mean moving range

fields.name: run
fields.means: ISO 7870-2:2023 test 2: the nine complete weeks ending at the latest high: all lie above the centre line; low: all below it; none: neither

meanings.rise: a special cause has moved the series up
meanings.fall: a special cause has moved the series down
meanings.steady: only common-cause variation: nothing to investigate
meanings.insufficient: no control limits can be computed yet, so no signal is claimed

rules.why: ISO 7870-2:2023: control limits are computed from 20 to 25 subgroups of preliminary data; with fewer, no point can be judged against them
ISO 7870-2:2023 test 1: one point beyond the upper control limit signals a special cause
ISO 7870-2:2023 test 1: one point beyond the lower control limit signals a special cause
ISO 7870-2:2023 test 2: nine points in a row on one side of the centre line signal a shift
ISO 7870-2:2023 test 2: nine points in a row on one side of the centre line signal a shift

app.otherwiseWhy: ISO 7870-2:2023: a process with no point beyond its limits and no run is in statistical control, and its variation has common causes only

properties.why: no signal is claimed without control limits
a series inside its limits with no run never signals
a series inside its limits with no run never signals
a point above the limit always signals a rise
